prompt: Refine the deployed Opening-Candle Cross screener in place. Independently for each scan date, select the top 300 stocks by volume of each stock's latest daily candle within the last 10 trading sessions ending on that date; exclude CE, PE, FUT suffixes and the NIFTY index. Expose universe_size (default 300, range 1-300) and liquidity_lookback (default 10, range 1-90). Evaluate only the 09:15-09:20 IST 5-minute candle. Require min(open, close) < X < max(open, close) for ALL stored sma20, sma50, sma200, and superTrend levels. Reject wick-only touches, equality, dojis, and missing indicators or OHLC. NIFTY direction is BUY when its opening candle closes above open and SHORT below; doji or missing NIFTY means no filter. Expose nifty_direction_filter with yes/no options, default yes and invalid values falling back to yes; when enabled reject opposing stock direction. Report calculation steps and qualification/rejection reasons without invented values. Select one trade per date by abs(close-open)/open*100 descending with symbol ascending for ties; report NO TRADE if none qualifies. Keep this selection separate from the confirmed all-matches table. Scan the last 60 trading sessions ending at the latest date with 5-minute candles by default; accept inclusive from_date/to_date YYYY-MM-DD with HTTP 400 for invalid/reversed ranges or spans over 90 calendar days. Evaluate one date at a time in bounded ClickHouse queries; history before from_date may supply liquidity data, but no future dates. Return one row per stock/date with range=high-low. Columns in order: stock as Symbol (text), scan_date as scan_date (text), high as High (price), low as Low (price), range as range (text), date as Candle time (datetime). Sort scan_date descending, group by date, and support symbol search, sortable headers, and from/to date controls. Show all matches with numbered pages of 10 and no default cap; optional limit applies per date and total counts all qualified matches before capping.
